correctness.rationale: The exact support function is the sum of two largest coordinate moduli. Its equality cases classify every positive-dimensional exposed face. A generic normal avoids all root vertices, and Coxeter-chamber reduction preserves each vertex sign. Counting strict mixed-sign faces yields \(d2^{d+2}\binom{n}{d+2}\) fixed-coordinate simplex crossings, \((2^{d+1}-4)\binom{n}{d+1}\) hypersimplex crossings, and \(2(n-1)\) coordinate-facet crossings, which give the asserted formulas for every \(n\ge5\) and all ranks. A standard-library exact-rational independent facet-intersection enumerator verified \(n=4,5,6\) for six normals each; these are consistency checks only.

value.rationale: The result determines the complete f-vector for all generic central sections of a canonical infinite root-polytope family, rather than a narrow sample or a single numerical count. Every generic normal has the same combinatorial section type, whose vertices number \(8\binom n3\) while facets number \(2^n+2n-6\). This yields a complete explicit combinatorial slicing benchmark for the recently studied \(D_8\) shell and extends beyond the already-known 24-cell and type-A classifications.
